source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: iam_handler.c hooks the index into PostgreSQL, build.c triggers the build via index_build.c, and scan.c runs the search through the centroids and then the posting lists. The computation relies on hierarchical clustering, RaBitQ quantization, fastscan and SIMD distances.
